SLUDGEWAVE.Description: It swamps the area around the user with a giant sludge wave. It may also poison those hit.

SMACKDOWN.Name: Smack Down
SMACKDOWN.Description: The user throws a stone or projectile to attack. A flying Pokémon will fall to the ground when hit.

SMARTSTRIKE.Name: Smart Strike
SMARTSTRIKE.Description: The user stabs the target with a sharp horn. This attack never misses.

SMELLINGSALTS.Name: Smelling Salts
SMELLINGSALTS.Description: This attack inflicts double damage on a paralyzed foe. It also cures the target's paralysis, however.

SMOG.Name: Smog
SMOG.Description: The target is attacked with a discharge of filthy gases. It may also poison the target.

SMOKESCREEN.Name: Smokescreen
SMOKESCREEN.Description: The user releases an obscuring cloud of smoke or ink. It reduces the target's accuracy.

SNAPTRAP.Name: Snap Trap
SNAPTRAP.Description: The user snares the target in a snap trap for four to five turns.

SNARL.Name: Snarl
SNARL.Description: The user yells as if it is ranting about something, making the target's Sp. Atk stat decrease.

SNATCH.Name: Snatch
SNATCH.Description: The user steals the effects of any healing or stat-changing move the foe attempts to use.

SNIPESHOT.Name: Snipe Shot
SNIPESHOT.Description: The user ignores any effects that redirect moves, allowing this move to hit the chosen target.

SNORE.Name: Snore
SNORE.Description: An attack that can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the target flinch.

SNOWSCAPE.Name: Snowscape
SNOWSCAPE.Description: Summons a five-turn snowstorm that boosts the Defense of Ice-type Pokémon.

SOAK.Name: Soak
SOAK.Description: The user shoots a torrent of water at the target and changes the target's type to Water.

SOFTBOILED.Name: Soft-Boiled
SOFTBOILED.Description: The user restores its own HP by up to half of its maximum HP. May also be used in the field to heal HP.

SOLARBEAM.Name: Solar Beam
SOLARBEAM.Description: A two-turn attack. The user gathers light, then blasts a bundled beam on the second turn.

SOLARBLADE.Name: Solar Blade
SOLARBLADE.Description: The user gathers light energy into a blade, attacking the target on the next turn.

SONICBOOM.Name: Sonic Boom
SONICBOOM.Description: The target is hit with a destructive shock wave that always inflicts 20 HP damage.

SPACIALREND.Name: Spacial Rend
SPACIALREND.Description: The user tears the target along with the space around it. Critical hits land more easily.

SPARK.Name: Spark
SPARK.Description: The user throws an electrically charged tackle at the target. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

SPARKLINGARIA.Name: Sparkling Aria
SPARKLINGARIA.Description: The user bursts into song, emitting many bubbles. Any burnt Pokémon will be healed by these bubbles.

SPARKLYSWIRL.Name: Sparkly Swirl
SPARKLYSWIRL.Description: The user attacks the target by wrapping it in a whirlwind of scent. This also heals all status conditions of the user's party.

SPECTRALTHIEF.Name: Spectral Thief
SPECTRALTHIEF.Description: The user hides in the target's shadow, steals the target's stat boosts, and then attacks.

SPEEDSWAP.Name: Speed Swap
SPEEDSWAP.Description: The user exchanges Speed stats with the target.

SPICYEXTRACT.Name: Spicy Extract
SPICYEXTRACT.Description: Emits a spicy extract which raises the target’s Attack and lowers Defense by two stages each.

SPIDERWEB.Name: Spider Web
SPIDERWEB.Description: The user ensnares the target with thin, gooey silk so it can't flee from battle.

SPIKECANNON.Name: Spike Cannon
SPIKECANNON.Description: Sharp spikes are shot at the target in rapid succession. They hit two to five times in a row.

SPIKES.Name: Spikes
SPIKES.Description: The user lays a trap of spikes at the foe's feet. The trap hurts foes that switch into battle.

SPIKYSHIELD.Name: Spiky Shield
SPIKYSHIELD.Description: Protects the user from attacks. Also damages attackers that make contact with the user.

SPINOUT.Name: Spin Out
SPINOUT.Description: The user inflicts damage on the target with a furious spin. This harshly lowers the user’s Speed.

SPIRITBREAK.Name: Spirit Break
SPIRITBREAK.Description: The user attacks the target with immense force. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

SPIRITSHACKLE.Name: Spirit Shackle
SPIRITSHACKLE.Description: The user attacks while also stitching the target's shadow to the ground to prevent it fleeing.

SPITE.Name: Spite
SPITE.Description: The user unleashes its grudge on the move last used by the target by cutting 4 PP from it.

SPITUP.Name: Spit Up
SPITUP.Description: The power stored using the move Stockpile is released all at once in an attack.

SPLASH.Name: Splash
SPLASH.Description: The user just flops and splashes around to no effect at all...

SPLISHYSPLASH.Name: Splishy Splash
SPLISHYSPLASH.Description: The user attacks by conjuring a huge, electrified wave. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

SPORE.Name: Spore
SPORE.Description: The user scatters bursts of spores that induce sleep.

SPOTLIGHT.Name: Spotlight
SPOTLIGHT.Description: The user shines a spotlight on the target so that only it will be attacked during the turn.

SPRINGTIDESTORM.Name: Springtide Storm
SPRINGTIDESTORM.Description: The user wraps winds of fierce emotion around opponents. This may lower their Attack stats.

STEALTHROCK.Name: Stealth Rock
STEALTHROCK.Description: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the foe. The trap hurts foes that switch into battle.

STEAMERUPTION.Name: Steam Eruption
STEAMERUPTION.Description: The user immerses the target in superheated steam. This may also leave the target with a burn.

STEAMROLLER.Name: Steamroller
STEAMROLLER.Description: The user crushes its foes by rolling over them. This attack may make the target flinch.

STEELBEAM.Name: Steel Beam
STEELBEAM.Description: The user fires a beam of steel that it collected from its entire body. This also damages the user.

STEELROLLER.Name: Steel Roller
STEELROLLER.Description: The user attacks while destroying the terrain. This move fails when the ground isn't a terrain.

STEELWING.Name: Steel Wing
STEELWING.Description: The target is hit with wings of steel. It may also raise the user's Defense stat.

STICKYWEB.Name: Sticky Web
STICKYWEB.Description: Weaves a sticky net around the opposing team, which lowers their Speed stats upon switching in.

STOCKPILE.Name: Stockpile
STOCKPILE.Description: The user charges up power and raises both its Defense and Sp. Def. The move can be used three times.

STOMP.Name: Stomp
STOMP.Description: The target is stomped with a big foot. It may also make the target flinch.

STOMPINGTANTRUM.Name: Stomping Tantrum
STOMPINGTANTRUM.Description: The user attacks driven by frustration. Power increases if the user's previous move failed.

STONEAXE.Name: Stone Axe
STONEAXE.Description: The user swings at the opponent with its stone axes. May leave floating rocks around the target.

STONEEDGE.Name: Stone Edge
STONEEDGE.Description: The user stabs the foe with sharpened stones from below. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

STOREDPOWER.Name: Stored Power
STOREDPOWER.Description: The user attacks with stored power. The more the user's stats are raised, the greater the damage.

STORMTHROW.Name: Storm Throw
STORMTHROW.Description: The user strikes the target with a fierce blow. This attack always results in a critical hit.

STRANGESTEAM.Name: Strange Steam
STRANGESTEAM.Description: The user attacks the target by emitting steam. This may also confuse the target.

STRENGTH.Name: Strength
STRENGTH.Description: The target is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power. It can also be used to move heavy boulders.

STRENGTHSAP.Name: Strength Sap
STRENGTHSAP.Description: The user restores its HP by the target's Attack stat amount. Then lowers the target's Attack stat.

STRINGSHOT.Name: String Shot
STRINGSHOT.Description: The foe is bound with silk blown from the user's mouth. This silk reduces the target's Speed.

STRUGGLEBUG.Name: Struggle Bug
STRUGGLEBUG.Description: While resisting, the user attacks the opposing Pokémon. The targets' Sp. Atk stat is reduced.

STUFFCHEEKS.Name: Stuff Cheeks
STUFFCHEEKS.Description: The user eats its held Berry, then sharply raises its Defense stat.

STUNSPORE.Name: Stun Spore
STUNSPORE.Description: The user scatters a cloud of paralyzing powder. It may leave the target with paralysis.

SUBMISSION.Name: Submission
SUBMISSION.Description: The user grabs the target and recklessly dives for the ground. It also hurts the user slightly.

SUBSTITUTE.Name: Substitute
SUBSTITUTE.Description: The user makes a copy of itself using some of its HP. The copy serves as the user's decoy.

SUCKERPUNCH.Name: Sucker Punch
SUCKERPUNCH.Description: This move enables the user to attack first. It fails if the target is not readying an attack, however.

SUNNYDAY.Name: Sunny Day
SUNNYDAY.Description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves.

SUNSTEELSTRIKE.Name: Sunsteel Strike
SUNSTEELSTRIKE.Description: The user slams into the target with the force of a meteor. Can't be stopped by the target's Ability.

SUPERCELLSLAM.Name: Supercell Slam
SUPERCELLSLAM.Description: The user drops onto the target with its electrified body. If it misses, the user is hurt instead.

SUPERFANG.Name: Super Fang
SUPERFANG.Description: The user chomps hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. It cuts the target's HP to half.

SUPERPOWER.Name: Superpower
SUPERPOWER.Description: The user attacks the target with great power. However, it also lowers the user's Attack and Defense.

SUPERSONIC.Name: Supersonic
SUPERSONIC.Description: The user generates odd sound waves from its body. It may confuse the target.

SURF.Description: It swamps the area around the user with a giant wave. It can also be used for crossing water.

SURGINGSTRIKES.Name: Surging Strikes
SURGINGSTRIKES.Description: Hits three times in a row with mastery of the Water style. This attack always deals critical hits.

SWAGGER.Name: Swagger
SWAGGER.Description: The user enrages and confuses the target. However, it also sharply raises the target's Attack stat.

SWALLOW.Name: Swallow
SWALLOW.Description: The power stored using the move Stockpile is absorbed by the user to heal its HP.

SWEETKISS.Name: Sweet Kiss
SWEETKISS.Description: The user kisses the target with a sweet, angelic cuteness that causes confusion.

SWEETSCENT.Name: Sweet Scent
SWEETSCENT.Description: A sweet scent that lowers the foe's evasiveness. It also lures wild Pokémon if used in grass, etc.

SWIFT.Name: Swift
SWIFT.Description: Star-shaped rays are shot at the opposing team. This attack never misses.

SWITCHEROO.Name: Switcheroo
SWITCHEROO.Description: The user trades held items with the target faster than the eye can follow.

SWORDSDANCE.Name: Swords Dance
SWORDSDANCE.Description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. It sharply raises the user's Attack stat.

SYNCHRONOISE.Name: Synchronoise
SYNCHRONOISE.Description: Using an odd shock wave, the user damages any Pokémon of the same type as the user.

SYNTHESIS.Name: Synthesis
SYNTHESIS.Description: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

SYRUPBOMB.Name: Syrup Bomb
SYRUPBOMB.Description: An explosion of sticky candy syrup, which drop the target's Speed stat each turn for three turns.

TACHYONCUTTER.Name: Tachyon Cutter
TACHYONCUTTER.Description: The user attacks by launching particle blades at the target twice in a row. This attack never misses.

TACKLE.Name: Tackle
TACKLE.Description: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.

TAILGLOW.Name: Tail Glow
TAILGLOW.Description: The user stares at flashing lights to focus its mind, drastically raising its Sp. Atk stat.

TAILSLAP.Name: Tail Slap
TAILSLAP.Description: The user attacks by striking the target with its hard tail. It hits the Pokémon two to five times in a row.

TAILWHIP.Name: Tail Whip
TAILWHIP.Description: The user wags its tail cutely, making opposing Pokémon less wary and lowering their Defense stat.

TAILWIND.Name: Tailwind
TAILWIND.Description: The user whips up a turbulent whirlwind that ups the Speed of all party Pokémon for four turns.

TAKEDOWN.Name: Take Down
TAKEDOWN.Description: A reckless, full-body charge attack for slamming into the foe. It also damages the user a little.

TAKEHEART.Name: Take Heart
TAKEHEART.Description: The user lifts its spirits, curing its own status conditions and boosting its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

TARSHOT.Name: Tar Shot
TARSHOT.Description: Pours sticky tar over the target, lowering its Speed and making it weaker to Fire-type moves.

TAUNT.Name: Taunt
TAUNT.Description: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.

TEARFULLOOK.Name: Tearful Look
TEARFULLOOK.Description: Gets teary eyed to make the target lose its will to fight. Lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk.

TEATIME.Name: Teatime
TEATIME.Description: The user has teatime with all the Pokémon in the battle. Each Pokémon eats its held Berry.

TECHNOBLAST.Name: Techno Blast
TECHNOBLAST.Description: The user fires a beam of light at its target. The type changes depending on the Drive the user holds.

TEETERDANCE.Name: Teeter Dance
TEETERDANCE.Description: The user performs a wobbly dance that confuses the Pokémon around it.

TELEKINESIS.Name: Telekinesis
TELEKINESIS.Description: The user makes the target float with its psychic power. The target is easier to hit for three turns.

TELEPORT.Name: Teleport
TELEPORT.Description: The user switches place with a party Pokémon. Also warps to the last Pokémon Center visited.

TEMPERFLARE.Name: Temper Flare
TEMPERFLARE.Description: The user attacks driven by frustration. Power increases if the user's previous move failed.

TERASTARSTORM.Name: Tera Starstorm
TERASTARSTORM.Description: When used by Terapagos in its Stellar Form, this move damages all opposing Pokémon.

TERRAINPULSE.Name: Terrain Pulse
TERRAINPULSE.Description: Utilizes the power of the terrain to attack. This move's type and power vary with the terrain.

THIEF.Name: Thief
THIEF.Description: The user attacks and steals the foe's held item simultaneously. It can't steal if the user holds an item.

THOUSANDARROWS.Name: Thousand Arrows
THOUSANDARROWS.Description: This move also hits Pokémon that are in the air. Those Pokémon are knocked down to the ground.

THOUSANDWAVES.Name: Thousand Waves
THOUSANDWAVES.Description: The user attacks with a wave that crawls along the ground. Those it hits can't flee from battle.

THRASH.Name: Thrash
THRASH.Description: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. It then becomes confused, however.

THROATCHOP.Name: Throat Chop
THROATCHOP.Description: The user attacks the target's throat. The target cannot use sound-based moves for two turns.

THUNDER.Name: Thunder
THUNDER.Description: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the foe to inflict damage. It may also leave the target paralyzed.

THUNDERBOLT.Name: Thunderbolt
THUNDERBOLT.Description: A strong electric blast is loosed at the target. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

THUNDERCAGE.Name: Thunder Cage
THUNDERCAGE.Description: The user traps the target in a cage of sparking electricity for four to five turns.

THUNDERCLAP.Name: Thunderclap
THUNDERCLAP.Description: This move enables the user to attack first. It fails if the target is not readying an attack, however.

THUNDERFANG.Name: Thunder Fang
THUNDERFANG.Description: The user bites with electrified fangs. It may also make the target flinch or leave it with paralysis.

THUNDEROUSKICK.Name: Thunderous Kick
THUNDEROUSKICK.Description: Overwhelms the target with lightning-like movement, then kicks. Lowers the target's Defense stat.

THUNDERPUNCH.Name: Thunder Punch
THUNDERPUNCH.Description: The target is punched with an electrified fist. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

THUNDERSHOCK.Name: Thunder Shock
THUNDERSHOCK.Description: A jolt of electricity is hurled at the foe to inflict damage. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

THUNDERWAVE.Name: Thunder Wave
THUNDERWAVE.Description: A weak electric charge is launched at the target. It causes paralysis if it hits.

TICKLE.Name: Tickle
TICKLE.Description: The user tickles the target into laughing, reducing its Attack and Defense stats.

TIDYUP.Name: Tidy Up
TIDYUP.Description: Clears hazards and substitutes from the field. This also boosts the user’s Attack and Speed.

TOPSYTURVY.Name: Topsy-Turvy
TOPSYTURVY.Description: All stat changes affecting the target turn topsy-turvy and become the opposite of what they were.

TORCHSONG.Name: Torch Song
TORCHSONG.Description: The user blows out raging flames as if singing a song. This also boosts the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

TORMENT.Name: Torment
TORMENT.Description: The user torments and enrages the foe, making it incapable of using the same move twice in a row.

TOXIC.Name: Toxic
TOXIC.Description: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

TOXICSPIKES.Name: Toxic Spikes
TOXICSPIKES.Description: The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the foe's feet. They poison foes that switch into battle.

TOXICTHREAD.Name: Toxic Thread
TOXICTHREAD.Description: The user shoots poisonous threads to poison the target and lower the target's Speed stat.

TRAILBLAZE.Name: Trailblaze
TRAILBLAZE.Description: The user attacks suddenly as if leaping out from tall grass. This boosts the user's Speed stat.

TRANSFORM.Name: Transform
TRANSFORM.Description: The user transforms into a copy of the target right down to having the same move set.

TRIATTACK.Name: Tri Attack
TRIATTACK.Description: The user strikes with a simultaneous three-beam attack. May also paralyze, burn, or freeze the target.

TRICK.Name: Trick
TRICK.Description: The user catches the target off guard and swaps its held item with its own.

TRICKORTREAT.Name: Trick-or-Treat
TRICKORTREAT.Description: The user takes the target trick-or-treating. This adds Ghost type to the target's type.

TRICKROOM.Name: Trick Room
TRICKROOM.Description: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.

TRIPLEARROWS.Name: Triple Arrows
TRIPLEARROWS.Description: The user fires arrows which may lower the target’s Defense or make it flinch. Critical hits land more easily.

TRIPLEAXEL.Description: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successful hit.

TRIPLEDIVE.Name: Triple Dive
TRIPLEDIVE.Description: The user performs a perfectly timed triple dive, hitting the target three times in a row.

TRIPLEKICK.Name: Triple Kick
TRIPLEKICK.Description: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successive hit.

TROPKICK.Name: Trop Kick
TROPKICK.Description: The user lands an intense tropical kick on the target. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.

TRUMPCARD.Name: Trump Card
TRUMPCARD.Description: The fewer PP this move has, the greater its attack power.

TWINBEAM.Name: Twin Beam
TWINBEAM.Description: The user shoots mystical beams from its eyes to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.

TWINEEDLE.Name: Twineedle
TWINEEDLE.Description: The foe is stabbed twice by a pair of stingers. It may also poison the target.

TWISTER.Name: Twister
TWISTER.Description: The user whips up a vicious tornado to tear at the opposing team. It may also make targets flinch.

UPPERHAND.Name: Upper Hand
UPPERHAND.Description: An attack that hits first and makes the target flinch. Fails if the target isn't using a high priority move.

UPROAR.Name: Uproar
UPROAR.Description: The user attacks in an uproar for three turns. Over that time, no one can fall asleep.

UTURN.Name: U-turn
UTURN.Description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

VACUUMWAVE.Name: Vacuum Wave
VACUUMWAVE.Description: The user whirls its fists to send a wave of pure vacuum at the target. This move always goes first.

VCREATE.Name: V-create
VCREATE.Description: With a fiery forehead, the user hurls itself at the foe. It lowers the user's Defense, Sp. Def, and Speed.

VENOMDRENCH.Name: Venom Drench
VENOMDRENCH.Description: Foes are drenched in an odd liquid that lowers the Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed of poisoned Pokémon.

VENOSHOCK.Name: Venoshock
VENOSHOCK.Description: The user drenches the foe in a special poisonous liquid. Its power doubles if the target is poisoned.

VICTORYDANCE.Name: Victory Dance
VICTORYDANCE.Description: The user performs an intense dance to usher in victory, raising its Attack, Defense, and Speed.

VINEWHIP.Name: Vine Whip
VINEWHIP.Description: The target is struck with slender, whiplike vines to inflict damage.

VISEGRIP.Name: Vise Grip
VISEGRIP.Description: The target is gripped and squeezed from both sides to inflict damage.

VITALTHROW.Name: Vital Throw
VITALTHROW.Description: The user attacks last. In return, this throw move is guaranteed not to miss.

VOLTSWITCH.Name: Volt Switch
VOLTSWITCH.Description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

VOLTTACKLE.Name: Volt Tackle
VOLTTACKLE.Description: The user electrifies itself, then charges at the foe. It causes considerable damage to the user as well.

WAKEUPSLAP.Name: Wake-Up Slap
WAKEUPSLAP.Description: This attack inflicts big damage on a sleeping target. It also wakes the target up, however.

WATERFALL.Name: Waterfall
WATERFALL.Description: The user charges at the target and may make it flinch. It can also be used to climb a waterfall.

WATERGUN.Name: Water Gun
WATERGUN.Description: The target is blasted with a forceful shot of water.

WATERPLEDGE.Name: Water Pledge
WATERPLEDGE.Description: A column of water strikes the target. When combined with its fire equivalent, it makes a rainbow.

WATERPULSE.Name: Water Pulse
WATERPULSE.Description: The user attacks the target with a pulsing blast of water. It may also confuse the target.

WATERSHURIKEN.Name: Water Shuriken
WATERSHURIKEN.Description: The user hits the target with throwing stars 2-5 times in a row. This move always goes first.

WATERSPORT.Name: Water Sport
WATERSPORT.Description: The user soaks itself with water. The move weakens Fire-type moves while the user is in the battle.

WATERSPOUT.Name: Water Spout
WATERSPOUT.Description: The user spouts water to damage the foe. The lower the user's HP, the less powerful it becomes.

WAVECRASH.Name: Wave Crash
WAVECRASH.Description: The user shrouds itself in water and slams into the target. This also damages the user.

WEATHERBALL.Name: Weather Ball
WEATHERBALL.Description: An attack move that varies in power and type depending on the weather.

WHIRLPOOL.Name: Whirlpool
WHIRLPOOL.Description: Traps foes in a violent swirling whirlpool for four to five turns.

WHIRLWIND.Name: Whirlwind
WHIRLWIND.Description: The foe is blown away, to be replaced by another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

WICKEDBLOW.Name: Wicked Blow
WICKEDBLOW.Description: Strikes with a fierce blow through mastery of the Dark style. Always results in a critical hit.

WIDEGUARD.Name: Wide Guard
WIDEGUARD.Description: The user and its allies are protected from wide-ranging attacks for a turn. May fail if used in succession.

WILDBOLTSTORM.Name: Wildbolt Storm
WILDBOLTSTORM.Description: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with a thunderous tempest. This may also leave them paralyzed.

WILDCHARGE.Name: Wild Charge
WILDCHARGE.Description: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its foe. It also damages the user a little.

WILLOWISP.Name: Will-O-Wisp
WILLOWISP.Description: The user shoots a sinister, bluish-white flame at the target to inflict a burn.

WINGATTACK.Name: Wing Attack
WINGATTACK.Description: The target is struck with large, imposing wings spread wide to inflict damage.

WISH.Name: Wish
WISH.Description: One turn after this move is used, the target's HP is restored by half the user's maximum HP.

WITHDRAW.Name: Withdraw
WITHDRAW.Description: The user withdraws its body into its hard shell, raising its Defense stat.

WONDERROOM.Name: Wonder Room
WONDERROOM.Description: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon's Defense and Sp. Def stats are swapped for 5 turns.

WOODHAMMER.Name: Wood Hammer
WOODHAMMER.Description: The user slams its rugged body into the target to attack. The user also sustains serious damage.

WORKUP.Name: Work Up
WORKUP.Description: The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk stats increase.

WORRYSEED.Name: Worry Seed
WORRYSEED.Description: A seed that causes worry is planted on the foe. It prevents sleep by making its Ability Insomnia.

WRAP.Name: Wrap
WRAP.Description: A long body or vines are used to wrap and squeeze the target for four to five turns.

WRINGOUT.Name: Wring Out
WRINGOUT.Description: The user powerfully wrings the foe. The more HP the foe has, the greater this attack's power.

XSCISSOR.Name: X-Scissor
XSCISSOR.Description: The user slashes at the foe by crossing its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors.

YAWN.Name: Yawn
YAWN.Description: The user lets loose a huge yawn that lulls the target into falling asleep on the next turn.

ZAPCANNON.Name: Zap Cannon
ZAPCANNON.Description: The user fires an electric blast like a cannon to inflict damage and cause paralysis.

ZENHEADBUTT.Name: Zen Headbutt
ZENHEADBUTT.Description: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the foe. It may also make the target flinch.

ZINGZAP.Name: Zing Zap
ZINGZAP.Description: A strong electric blast crashes down on the target. This may also make the target flinch.

ADAPTABILITY.Name: Adaptability
ADAPTABILITY.Description: Powers up moves of the same type.

AERILATE.Name: Aerilate
AERILATE.Description: Normal-type moves become Flying-type and power up.

AFTERMATH.Name: Aftermath
AFTERMATH.Description: Damages the attacker landing the finishing hit.

ANALYTIC.Name: Analytic
ANALYTIC.Description: Boosts move power when the Pokémon moves last.

ANGERPOINT.Name: Anger Point
ANGERPOINT.Description: Maxes Attack after taking a critical hit.

ANGERSHELL.Name: Anger Shell
ANGERSHELL.Description: Gets a powerful boost if a hit makes its HP half or less.

ARMORTAIL.Name: Armor Tail
ARMORTAIL.Description: Prevents opposing Pokémon from using priority moves.

AROMAVEIL.Name: Aroma Veil
AROMAVEIL.Description: Protects against attacks that limit move choices.

ASONECHILLINGNEIGH.Name: As One
ASONECHILLINGNEIGH.Description: Combines Unnerve and Chilling Neigh Abilities.

ASONEGRIMNEIGH.Name: As One
ASONEGRIMNEIGH.Description: Combines Unnerve and Grim Neigh Abilities.

AURABREAK.Name: Aura Break
AURABREAK.Description: Reverses "Aura" Abilities to weaken affected moves.

BALLFETCH.Name: Ball Fetch
BALLFETCH.Description: Retrieves the first thrown Poké Ball if it failed.

BATTERY.Name: Battery
BATTERY.Description: Powers up ally Pokémon's special moves.

BATTLEARMOR.Name: Battle Armor
BATTLEARMOR.Description: The Pokémon is protected against critical hits.

BATTLEBOND.Name: Battle Bond
BATTLEBOND.Description: Defeating a foe powers up the user one time.

BEADSOFRUIN.Name: Beads of Ruin
BEADSOFRUIN.Description: Lowers the Sp. Def of all Pokémon except the user.

BEASTBOOST.Name: Beast Boost
BEASTBOOST.Description: Boosts its best stat each time it deals a KO.

BERSERK.Name: Berserk
BERSERK.Description: Ups Sp. Atk if a hit makes its HP half or less.

BLAZE.Name: Blaze
BLAZE.Description: Powers up Fire-type moves in a pinch.

CHEEKPOUCH.Name: Cheek Pouch
CHEEKPOUCH.Description: Restores HP as well when the Pokémon eats a Berry.

CHILLINGNEIGH.Name: Chilling Neigh
CHILLINGNEIGH.Description: When knocking out a target, raises Attack.

CHLOROPHYLL.Name: Chlorophyll
CHLOROPHYLL.Description: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed in sunshine.

CLEARBODY.Name: Clear Body
CLEARBODY.Description: Prevents other Pokémon from lowering its stats.

COLORCHANGE.Name: Color Change
COLORCHANGE.Description: Changes the Pokémon's type to the foe's move.

COMATOSE.Name: Comatose
COMATOSE.Description: It's always drowsing, and attacks without waking.

COMMANDER.Name: Commander
COMMANDER.Description: Pairs up and commands with an active Dondozo.

COMPETITIVE.Name: Competitive
COMPETITIVE.Description: Sharply boosts Sp. Atk when a stat is lowered.

CONTRARY.Name: Contrary
CONTRARY.Description: Makes stat changes have an opposite effect.

COSTAR.Name: Costar
COSTAR.Description: Copies an ally's stat changes upon entry to battle.

COTTONDOWN.Name: Cotton Down
COTTONDOWN.Description: Scatters Speed-lowering cotton fluff when hit.

CUDCHEW.Name: Cud Chew
CUDCHEW.Description: Reuses an eaten Berry at the end of the next turn.

CURIOUSMEDICINE.Name: Curious Medicine
CURIOUSMEDICINE.Description: Removes all allies' stat changes on joining battle.

CURSEDBODY.Name: Cursed Body
CURSEDBODY.Description: May disable a move used on the Pokémon.

CUTECHARM.Name: Cute Charm
CUTECHARM.Description: Contact with the Pokémon may cause infatuation.

DAMP.Name: Damp
DAMP.Description: Prevents the use of self-destructing moves.

DANCER.Name: Dancer
DANCER.Description: Repeats another Pokémon's dance move immediately.

DARKAURA.Name: Dark Aura
DARKAURA.Description: Powers up each Pokémon's Dark-type moves.

DAUNTLESSSHIELD.Name: Dauntless Shield
DAUNTLESSSHIELD.Description: Boosts Defense when entering battle one time.

DAZZLING.Name: Dazzling
DAZZLING.Description: Makes foes unable to use priority attacks.

DEFEATIST.Name: Defeatist
DEFEATIST.Description: Lowers stats when HP becomes half or less.

DEFIANT.Name: Defiant
DEFIANT.Description: When its stats are lowered its Attack increases.

DELTASTREAM.Name: Delta Stream
DELTASTREAM.Description: Alters weather to remove Flying-type's weaknesses.

DESOLATELAND.Name: Desolate Land
DESOLATELAND.Description: Changes the weather to nullify Water-type moves.

DISGUISE.Name: Disguise
DISGUISE.Description: Its shroud protects it from an attack just once.

DOWNLOAD.Name: Download
DOWNLOAD.Description: Adjusts power according to a foe's defenses.

DRIZZLE.Name: Drizzle
DRIZZLE.Description: The Pokémon makes it rain if it appears in battle.

DROUGHT.Name: Drought
DROUGHT.Description: Turns the sunlight harsh if it is in battle.

DRYSKIN.Name: Dry Skin
